name: Menubar
description:
An application's menu bar, as data: commands, toggles, choices, groups and submenus, with the
WAI-ARIA menubar keyboard pattern from Base UI. Left and right arrows follow the reading
direction, and once a menu is open, hovering another trigger switches to it.

Rows show keys and never listen for them, so the same definition can go to the palette and
the keymap (R1.2): build rows from an action set with `useMenubarActions`. A menu or submenu
can load its rows when it opens, with the space reserved. It folds into one menu when the box
it is given is too narrow (R7.6), and a menu taller than the space scrolls.

The bar draws no surface: place it in a window's header or a panel, which owns the frame.
signature: ({ "aria-label": label, menus, openMenu, defaultOpenMenu, onOpenMenuChange, onCommand, focusAfterCommand, collapse, size, disabled, labels, className, }: MenubarProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the bar for assistive technology ("Application").

props.name: collapse
props.description:
`auto` (default) folds the menus into one when they do not fit the box the bar is given,
whatever the viewport. `never` keeps the row; `always` keeps one menu.

props.name: defaultOpenMenu
props.description: The menu open at first when uncontrolled. Default none.

props.name: focusAfterCommand
props.description:
Where focus goes after a command runs, such as the document the menu acts on. Escape still
returns to the trigger, and an outside press leaves focus where it landed. Without it, a
command returns focus to the trigger like any menu.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ menu: string; loading: string; loadFailed: string; retry: string; empty: string; }> | undefined

props.name: onCommand
props.description: Called with a command row's id and row after the menu closes, after the row's own `onSelect`.

props.name: onOpenMenuChange
props.description: Called with the menu that opened, or null when the bar closed.

props.name: openMenu
props.description: The open menu's id, or null. Controlled while defined. While collapsed the value is `MENUBAR_COLLAPSED_MENU`.

props.name: size
props.description: sm (default) for window and panel chrome, md for a page's top row.
